# Three.js r180

Pinned `three@0.180.0` ES module builds, distributed locally so the experience
does not rely on a third-party CDN at runtime.

- `three.module.min.js` and `three.core.min.js`: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.180.0
- Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
- License: MIT, included in `LICENSE`. Upstream copyright headers are preserved.

Only `wishes.html` uses these files, through a lazy import of `anh-ar-scene.js`.
